lines.beaver_en: Have you sorted out the locations at the site?
lines.en: Yes, I walked around the site in all four directions.

lines.beaver_en: Did you check the whole inside of the building?
lines.learner: 네, 내부는 위아래 층까지 다 봤어요.
lines.en: Yes, I checked the inside, upstairs and downstairs too.
lines.roman: ne, naebuneun wiarae cheungkkaji da bwasseoyo.

lines.learner: 전시관 한가운데에 있어요. 정면에 입구가 있어요.
lines.en: It's in the very middle of the exhibition hall. The entrance is at the front.
lines.roman: jeonsigwan hangaundee isseoyo. jeongmyeone ipguga isseoyo.

lines.en: It's near Jongno 2-ga, so it's always busy inside and out.

lines.beaver_en: Is it close to the station?
lines.en: It's five minutes from the station, so you could say it's in the station area.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't it far to come from the outskirts?
lines.learner: 아니요, 수도권 근교에서도 한 시간이면 와요.
lines.en: No, even from the outskirts of the capital region it takes an hour.
lines.roman: aniyo, sudogwon geungyoeseodo han siganimyeon wayo.

lines.en: At the very bottom of the building, on basement level 3.
lines.roman: geonmul maen arae, jiha samcheunge isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard there's an observation deck too.
lines.en: Yes, it's on the top floor. You get there by elevator.
The east side is a restaurant street, and the west is a park.

lines.beaver: 정리 고마워요. 이제 준비 다 된 거죠?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for summing it up. So we're all ready now, right?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongni gomawoyo. ije junbi da doen geojyo?
lines.learner: 네, 위치 정리는 다 끝났어요. 참고해 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, the location summary is all done. Please refer to it.
lines.roman: ne, wichi jeongnineun da kkeunnasseoyo. chamgohae juseyo.
